instruction: Candid medium-shot photograph in a grassy park with a sloping hill. On the left, the bald man in the navy t-shirt (R2) is seen from a three-quarter back view, gesturing with his right arm toward the large Black man in the dark blue t-shirt (R1) on the right. The large Black man (R1), wearing clear safety glasses, smiles warmly and gestures back with his left hand. Soft, warm daylight illuminates the scene.
